drivingQuestion: Does a twenty-year-old without signs have the same status as a nine-year-old?
outcomeNote: the contradiction continues and is answered in the next unit

segments.he: אֶחָד בֶּן תֵּשַׁע שָׁנִים וְכוּ׳. וּרְמִינְהוּ: בֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה שֶׁלֹּא הֵבִיא שְׁתֵּי שְׂעָרוֹת — יָבִיאוּ רְאָיָה שֶׁהוּא בֶּן עֶשְׂרִים, וְהוּא הַסָּרִיס — לֹא חוֹלֵץ וְלֹא מְיַיבֵּם.
segments.en: § The Gemara addresses the statement of the mishna that this is the halakha «both» for a boy «who is nine years» and one day old as well as a twenty-year old who has not developed two pubic hairs. In both cases, their sexual relations are not considered proper intercourse with regard to levirate marriage. «And» the Gemara «raises a contradiction» against this from the following source: With regard to a man «twenty years old who has not developed two» pubic «hairs, they must bring proof that he is twenty years old, and» he «is» established as «a eunuch,» who «may neither perform ḥalitza nor perform levirate marriage.»
